# N3: Review notes, attention-home

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/3-attention-home.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Lane's review notes (5 Nov), attention-home. [ATTENTION-HANDLED] "Needs attention" means new since someone looked; a goal behind but looked at since its latest check-in is "Being handled", with what's in hand, everywhere. [HOME-OWNER] Home opens on what is asked of you today, or one quiet line; your goals are counted once, in "Your goals", each count opening exactly those goals; and it shows what you own and what you watch.
